_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings_rows" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "pay_frequency" TEXT NOT NULL, "next_payday" TEXT NOT NULL, "income_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NULL, "hourly_rate_cents" INTEGER NULL, "week_starts_on" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 7, "theme" TEXT NOT NULL, "app_lock_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("app_lock_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "overspend_strategy" TEXT NOT NULL, "onboarded" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("onboarded" IN (0, 1)), "last_backup_on" TEXT NULL, "remind_log_spends" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("remind_log_spends" IN (0, 1)), "remind_log_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1230, "remind_bills" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("remind_bills" IN (0, 1)), "remind_late_pause" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("remind_late_pause" IN (0, 1)), "remind_recaps" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("remind_recaps" IN (0, 1)), "remind_backup" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("remind_backup" IN (0, 1)), "quiet_from" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1380, "remind_payday" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("remind_payday" IN (0, 1)), "remind_payday_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 540, "remind_debts_owed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("remind_debts_owed" IN (0, 1)), "remind_debts_you_owe" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("remind_debts_you_owe" IN (0, 1)), "biometric_unlock" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("biometric_unlock" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cycle_plans" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "opening_balance_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "goal_set_aside_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "tone" TEXT NOT NULL, "monthly_limit_cents" INTEGER NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("amount_cents" > 0), "local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at_utc" INTEGER NOT NULL, "time_zone_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "merchant" TEXT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL, "mood" TEXT NULL, "planned" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("planned" IN (0, 1)), "note" TEXT NULL, "split_id" TEXT NULL, "to_vault" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("to_vault" IN (0, 1)), "from_vault" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("from_vault" IN (0, 1)), "bill_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "bills" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "recurrence" TEXT NOT NULL, "due_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_estimate" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_estimate" IN (0, 1)), "is_subscription" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_subscription" IN (0, 1)), "needs_review" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("needs_review" IN (0, 1)), "last_paid_on" TEXT NULL, "previous_amount_cents" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "goals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "saved_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "daily_set_aside_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "target_date" TEXT NULL, "paused" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("paused" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_on" TEXT NULL, "cycle_set_aside_cents" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "vaults" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "opening_balance_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "steady_pay_weekly_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "target_weeks" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 4, "last_release_date" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "split_people" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "remind_muted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("remind_muted" IN (0, 1)), "remind_snoozed_until" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "split_groups" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "method" TEXT NOT NULL, "simplify_debts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("simplify_debts" IN (0, 1)), "created_on" TEXT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "split_group_members" ("group_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "person_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "weight" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("group_id", "person_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "group_expenses" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "paid_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "entry_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "group_expense_shares" ("expense_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "person_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "share_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("expense_id", "person_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "split_settlements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "group_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "from_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "to_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "entry_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "overspend_decisions" ("local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "strategy" TEXT NOT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL, "amount_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("local_date"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "daily_numbers" ("local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "allowance_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("local_date"));
